name: Yabuki Aoi
source:
A cheerful married woman who is a former Yankee. She is from the same hometown as the main character. She is angry and scary, but she was like a neighborhood sister whom he admired. Her husband returned home alone due to urgent work.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1097949]Getchu[/url]]
